--- layout: default type_slug: gantt title: Gantt Chart in C# — Project Timelines as SVG nav_title: Gantt Chart description: Generate Gantt charts in C# with AddGantt and GanttTask — task bars on a time axis, per-task colours, rendered as self-contained SVG for reports and PDFs. permalink: /chart/types/gantt/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} using TerraFluent.Chart.Reporting.Models; string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("Release Plan (weeks)") .Size(760, 380) .XAxis(x => { x.Title = "Week"; x.Min = 0; x.Max = 12; }) .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddGantt("Schedule", new[] { new GanttTask { Name = "Design", Start = 0, End = 3 }, new GanttTask { Name = "Development", Start = 2, End = 8, Color = ChartColor.ChartBlue }, new GanttTask { Name = "Testing", Start = 7, End = 10 }, new GanttTask { Name = "Launch", Start = 10, End = 12, Color = ChartColor.ChartGreen }, })) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
